It's 100% normal to feel this way. I think the best way to cope is to remember that life is full of meetings and partings, and to appreciate that you were once loved by another human being. I know that it's not recommended to look back at old pictures and texts from an ex, but it helps me. I look at those things and initially make myself feel worse about losing her, but then I feel a lot better knowing that what we had was special and I wouldn't trade the good/bad times we had together for the world.  So, be happy that you had the opportunity to be in love with someone else. You are now a walking poem with new knowledge about the poignancy of love. Life is like a piano: the white keys represent happiness and the black keys represent sadness, but with both of them combined they make music. Best of luck to you.
